environment_notes: Fresh clone on the existing Apple Silicon Mac; Docker cache and authenticated GitHub access are available.
No repository fixes will be made until the trial steps are complete.
Tester has prior repository familiarity from reviews and targeted fixes; owner accepts this tester trial and will recruit additional testers.

steps.method: Read repair.json and wrote the tester answers below; reading began during the earlier log inspection, no separate start timestamp was captured.

runner_errors.cause: Harness started the build before clone completion; not a product failure.

verified_requirements.REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: Every payout satisfying the locked validity predicate succeeds.
verified_requirements.REQ-INVALID-NOOP: Invalid requests are rejected with the state unchanged.
verified_requirements.REQ-AUTHORIZATION: A successful payout must be authorized for its source.
verified_requirements.REQ-EFFECTS: Successful balances equal the specified expected balances; the account universe and authorization relation stay unchanged.
verified_requirements.REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: Success adds exactly the request ID to the applied IDs; repeating the same request is rejected without changing state.
verified_requirements.REQ-NONNEGATIVE: Starting with nonnegative balances cannot produce a negative balance.
verified_requirements.REQ-FAIR-SHARES: On success each recipient gets exactly the specified fairShare for its index.

answers.trust: The owner-reviewed specification must express the intended policy. The result also relies on the Lean kernel/compiler/runtime, Comparator and its sandbox, and the recorded judge image. This repair uses Quot.sound and propext; Classical.choice is permitted but not reported as used.
answers.tested_not_proved: The executable JSON parser/serializer in app/Main.lean is tested, not proved. The proof concerns pure Payout.step definitions; it is not an end-to-end proof of the website.
answers.reproduction: Keep the Passport and exact Solution.lean, clone the matching repository/specification, build the pinned judge image, and run bin/proofforge verify with those two paths. Cross-architecture reproduction rebuilds and tests the binary but does not compare its hash.
answers.unclear_instructions: Step 5 requires editing a Lean predicate without specifying an example, despite saying Lean experience is unnecessary. Copying a small exact mutation would help a novice. The check output also prints passport.json after --out repair.json, requiring the user to substitute the actual filename.
answers.unexpected_results: All specified substantive outcomes matched. The reproduced executable hash was explicitly skipped across architectures, as documented. One premature image-build invocation was a tester harness error, recorded separately, and was retried only after clone completion.
answers.usefulness: This would be useful for small pure routines with costly invariant violations, such as accounting transitions or permission decisions. Adoption depends on the cost of expressing and reviewing the intended specification, Lean integration, and the boundary between proved logic and unproved I/O. This is a tester assessment, not a claim of actual adoption.
answers.other: The visible split between recorded agent work and a fresh judge check is clear. Downloading both source and Passport makes the result inspectable. This trial used an existing Docker cache and authenticated checkout, so its 5.4-second image build does not measure a cold install.

findings.finding: check --out repair.json prints and embeds a reproduce command referring to passport.json. The actual output file is repair.json.
findings.suggestion: Use the requested output filename in the reproduce command, and finalize it before computing the Passport content hash.

findings.finding: Step 5 asks a tester without Lean experience to weaken any statement, without an exact example.
findings.suggestion: Provide one complete scratch-file mutation or command so the test measures product usability rather than Lean familiarity.

findings.finding: Voiceover says the executable hash matches the Passport, but PayoutForm compares response.solution_sha256 with passportSolutionSha.
findings.suggestion: Say the source hash matches the Passport. The recording uses this corrected wording.

outcome: All substantive protocol expectations passed; minor guidance and storyboard findings, no blocking product defect observed.
